You MAY NOT add new sounds, unheard instruments, loudness, pitch, rhythm, direction of audio, or speculative emotions/intent. A visual location is allowed (e.g. an object landing on grass); an auditory location is not (e.g. sound from behind the viewer). If no supported extra detail exists, return equal levels and explain the limitation. Do not use background scenery as filler.

Do not invent detail to meet length. Caption only the target reference interval, not surrounding events.
